Output.Name: HumanConfidence
Output.Description: The confidence that the request came from a device being used by a human who is viewing the page. Returns one of High, Medium, Low, or Unknown.

Values.Name: High
Values.Description: High confidence that the request is from a device being used by a human who is viewing the page.

Values.Name: Medium
Values.Description: The evidence is mixed and the request cannot be placed either way. A human may be viewing the page.

Values.Name: Low
Values.Description: Almost certainly no human is directly involved in viewing the page content.

Values.Name: Unknown
Values.Description: There was not enough evidence to rate the confidence. This is the default where none of the checks could be evaluated.
